newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers gets OTC okay for Vagistat-1.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers gets OTC okay for Vagistat-1.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Wednesday it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market Vagistat-1, a vaginal ointment, as an over-the-counter treatment for vaginal yeast infections.

The company said the ointment is the first one-dose medication for vaginal yeast infections approved for use without a prescription. All other OTC medications for vaginal yeast infections require three or seven days of treatment, it said.
It said VAGISTAT-1 will be available shortly in drug and food stores as well as mass merchandise outlets nationwide.
